blockers.title: Probe spawns base interpreter instead of pinned venv
blockers.summary: launch_once.py spawns resolved_target (uv base cpython-3.12.15/bin/python3.12), not lexical_path (python/.venv/bin/python). Under -I -B the base binary sees neither numpy nor torch. probe.py:152-153 imports them outside the try block, so the child exits 1 with no probe-result after the marker is claimed.
blockers.evidence: Read-only check: base binary under -I -B reports sys.prefix = uv base; find_spec numpy and torch both None.
blockers.failure_scenario: Parent writes a matching reservation; launcher claims the one-shot marker at line 154; child fails at import with no MPS measurement and no evidence; one-shot consumed.
blockers.fix: Spawn lexical venv path. Before the marker, run a CPU-only lexical -I -B check asserting sys.prefix is the venv directory and numpy/torch origins are under python/.venv. Add a test asserting spawn argv[0]. Re-freeze plan and pins; re-review.
blockers.test_gap: test_calibration_cpu.py:32 uses sys.executable and a harmless child that imports nothing.

blockers.title: Bytecode written into frozen R6 directory; receipt claim false
blockers.summary: In-process loads of R6 worker.py (and paired_eval.py and runtime dodge_rl) have no bytecode guard. R6 __pycache__ worker and paired_eval .pyc files are dated 2026-10-25 22:16:57, after the 22:02 R6 freeze and within the R3 preparation window. preparation-receipt.json still states writes_outside_new_r3_directory: false.
blockers.failure_scenario: Nested imports write .pyc into frozen R6 or runtime directories; pins exclude __pycache__, so pin checks pass while frozen directories change.
blockers.fix: sys.dont_write_bytecode = True before any import in launch_once.py, cpu_preflight.py, probe.py, and the test file. Parent commands use -B and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1. Correct the receipt. Parent decides ownership of the existing cache; this review did not delete it.
blockers.test_gap: test_calibration_cpu.py:166 loads R6 worker without bytecode suppression.

blockers.title: MPS gate can pass with zero or unmeasured MPS data
blockers.summary: mps_peak uses max(..., default=0) and the cap check passes at 0. worker.read_latest_resource_sample accepts any non-negative int for mps_driver_bytes. mps_sampler_query_success_count is recorded but not required.
blockers.failure_scenario: A sampler returning 0 on every sample passes the 6 GiB MPS cap while measuring nothing. Same class as R6 B-4.
blockers.fix: For status passed require mps_sampler_query_success_count == resource_sample_count and mps_driver_highwater_bytes > 0.

narrow_findings.summary: Active window does not stop at 45 s as the plan says; plan success_gates carries stale mps_forward_calls 8 beside the minimum 240.

RSS monitor: poll check precedes ps, but a child exiting as a zombie during ps can return rc 0 with zero RSS. Line 182 raises, monitor_error is set, and the launcher fails after a successful probe with no launcher-result.
narrow_findings.fix: After ps, return if process.poll() is not None before validating value.

narrow_findings.summary: Evidence counters are hard-coded constants: pins_checked_before_and_after 2, pins_checked_before_import_and_mps 3 (set even on early failure), term_sent True, observer disposition strings.

Live gate checks five fields; production worker._lease_check also requires kind, review_status, campaign_launch_authorized, no_concurrent_long_mps_training, and review hashes. Fails closed on current state.

Plan anchors not enforced in code: reviewed plan SHA b65924, cpu_preflight_evidence_sha256 4737c9, preparation receipt SHA b7724a3f. Reservation plan_sha256 is the only binding; parent must verify b65924 before writing the reservation.
--output is caller-chosen; marker is fixed so one-shot holds, but evidence location is not pinned.
Test gaps: CLI tests stub spec_from_file_location so real CPU preflight never runs on CLI path; sys.executable masks B-1; launcher.MARKER set globally without restore.
Timeout identity is recorded but not compared before signals. start_new_session makes PGID equal PID, so no foreign group is signalled. Acceptable; evidence label overstates the check.
